regime_context: Hong Kong thematic landscape is sharply narrowed by the absolute-trend gate: only Banks, High-Dividend Blue Chips, and Industrials & Infrastructure are eligible. Banks hold a dominant leader position with a wide margin over the challenger, while most themes are ineligible and likely in downtrends. The macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitical and monetary surprises (unscheduled share 1.0), adding coincident noise.
emerging_watch: China Tech & Internet (3033.HK): the only scorable theme, currently ineligible and rank 6. Watch for a confirmed handoff: theme becomes eligible AND rank rises to ≤3. Kill-criterion: remains ineligible and rank ≥7 after 15 trading days.
